reason: A workspace integration plugin that applies native direnv environments to agent-scoped Bash execution and local stdio MCP processes, while delegating .envrc evaluation and authorization to the installed direnv executable.

summaries.zh: 将本机原生 direnv 环境应用到归属于工作区的 Bash 命令和本地 stdio MCP 进程。
summaries.en: Applies the host system's native direnv environments to workspace-scoped Bash commands and local stdio MCP processes.

capabilities: Executes direnv for workspace-scoped Bash commands
Wraps workspace-local stdio MCP process commands with direnv
Applies environment changes produced by user-authorized .envrc files
Invokes external executables through process spawning
